detail: PWPW signed an agreement with Banco de Guatemala, the central bank of Guatemala, on 20 August 2018 to produce 5- and 10-quetzal banknotes on a substrate containing synthetic fibres, with production to start later in 2018; PWPW's president called it the biggest order in its co-operation with the Guatemalan central bank to date. No contract value is stated.
source_title: PWPW to manufacture notes for Guatemala (Polska Wytwórnia Papierów Wartościowych)

name_as_stated: De La Rue, a security printing firm based in the United Kingdom
detail: In a report on the Bank of Ghana's upgraded cedi notes signed on 4 March 2019 and announced on 8 April 2019, retired Bank of Ghana Deputy Governor Emmanuel Asiedu-Mante states that the cedi is printed by De La Rue, a security printing firm based in the United Kingdom, and that the printer charges in British pounds. No contract value is given.
source_title: See the company that prints the Ghana Cedi notes (Daily Graphic / Graphic Online)

detail: Danmarks Nationalbank has signed an agreement with De La Rue to produce Denmark's new banknote series at De La Rue's facility outside London; the notes are due for launch in 2028 and the contract runs for a minimum of six years with an option to extend. No value is stated.
source_title: De La Rue Wins Contract to Print Denmark's New Series (Currency News)

detail: The same report states that Denmark's own printworks closed in 2016 and that Oberthur Fiduciaire has printed Danish banknotes for Danmarks Nationalbank since 2018.
source_title: De La Rue Wins Contract to Print Denmark's New Series (Currency News)

entity: Security Plant Complex, Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas
detail: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas prints its banknotes at its own Security Plant Complex in Quezon City, which printed 3.098 billion banknotes in 2019; the BSP also sends some printing to outside firms as a temporary stop-gap measure for demand surges, and plans a new Currency Production Facility in New Clark City, Tarlac. No outside printer is named.
source_title: BSP to print all banknotes (Manila Bulletin)

entity: Institute for Manufacturing Banknotes and Coins - Topčider
name_as_stated: the Institute for Manufacturing Banknotes and Coins
detail: The National Bank of Serbia states that its Institute at Topčider makes 'banknotes and coins issued by the NBS', alongside products for foreign countries; the Institute was built from 1927 and began operating in December 1929 as the Institute for Manufacturing Banknotes of the Kingdom of Yugoslavia, with a mint added in 1937.
source_title: Institute for Manufacturing Banknotes and Coins (National Bank of Serbia)

entity: Banknote Factory of the National Bank of Kazakhstan
name_as_stated: RSE "Banknote Factory of the National Bank"
detail: The National Bank of Kazakhstan lists the Banknote Factory of the National Bank among its subsidiaries and states that its main activity is the production of banknotes, along with other security printing (passports, ID and payment cards); the factory has released three series of tenge banknotes and eight commemorative or jubilee banknotes.
source_title: Subsidiaries (National Bank of Kazakhstan)

detail: Landqart states that the National Bank of Kazakhstan's 20,000 tenge banknote, issued for the 30th anniversary of Independence, is printed on Landqart's Durasafe composite substrate, and that it is the second note the bank has issued on that substrate; Landqart describes a partnership with the Banknote Factory of the National Bank of Kazakhstan.
source_title: The National Bank of Kazakhstan announce their new 20000 Tenge banknote (Landqart)

detail: A Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) press release on the NT$200 banknote states that 'the new banknotes are printed by China Engraving & Printing Works'.
source_title: Press release on the NT$200 banknote (Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan))

entity: Note Printing Works, Bank of Thailand
name_as_stated: the Note Printing Works at the Bank of Thailand
detail: The Bank of Thailand states that its own Note Printing Works was established to control the quantity and quality of banknotes and supports Thai banknote production; the Cabinet authorised it on 5 September 1961, construction began 8 August 1963, operations began 24 June 1969, and a new Note Printing Works in Nakhon Pathom province was inaugurated on 15 October 2007. The Bank's banknote production page describes design, platemaking, offset/intaglio/letterpress printing, inspection and packaging of Bank of Thailand banknotes.
as_of: operating since 24 June 1969; current site since 15 October 2007
source_title: The History of the Note Printing Works (Bank of Thailand)

entity: Fábrica de Billetes del Banco de México
name_as_stated: la fábrica de billetes de Banxico
entity_hq_city: Mexico City and El Salto, Jalisco
detail: Banco de México makes its own banknotes in all denominations at its two banknote factories, in Mexico City and in El Salto, Jalisco; the notes it first circulated in 1925 were made by the American Bank Note Company of New York, and banknote printing moved to Banco de México's own factory in Mexico in 1969.
source_title: ¿Quién hace los billetes mexicanos? (Expansión)

entity: Banco de la República (Imprenta de Billetes)
name_as_stated: el Banco de la República ... realiza la producción, emisión, provisión, cambio y destrucción de billetes y monedas
detail: Banco de la República states that it itself carries out the production, issuance, supply, exchange and destruction of Colombia's banknotes and coins; its site navigation places the Imprenta de Billetes (banknote printing works) under its Central de Efectivo, and locates its coin plant at Ibagué, Tolima. The page does not give the printing works' location.
source_title: Emisión de la moneda legal colombiana (Banco de la República)

name_as_stated: Casa da Moeda do Brasil – CMB
detail: The Banco Central do Brasil's FAQ on the second family of real banknotes states that the new notes were produced 'em parceria com a Casa da Moeda do Brasil – CMB', and that CMB's new banknote printing production lines were bought through a 2009 tender with installation and testing being completed in 2010.
source_title: Perguntas e respostas - segunda família de cédulas do Real (Banco Central do Brasil)

entity: Banknote Printing Plant, Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye
name_as_stated: the Banknote Printing Plant which is a subsidiary of the CBRT
detail: The Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye states: 'In Türkiye, banknotes are designed and printed at the Banknote Printing Plant which is a subsidiary of the CBRT.' No date is given.
source_title: Banknote Printing (Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye)

detail: Bank Al-Maghrib states that its industrial unit Dar As-Sikkah prints Morocco's banknotes and mints its coins, and also makes the national passport and other security documents; it was founded in 1987 and inaugurated by King Hassan II on 5 March 1987, a second banknote production line was added in 1992, it has printed foreign banknotes since 1995, and equipment modernisation began in 2008.
source_title: Activities of Dar As-Sikkah (Bank Al-Maghrib)

entity: Korea Minting and Security Printing Corporation (KOMSCO)
name_as_stated: Korea Minting and Security Printing Corp.
detail: The Korea Times describes KOMSCO as the state-run mint and 'the country's sole manufacturer of banknotes and coins', and says it maintains a close partnership with the Bank of Korea.
source_title: State-run mint debuts art exhibition highlighting printing technology (The Korea Times)

detail: De La Rue states that the Eastern Caribbean Central Bank's EC$2 commemorative polymer banknote is designed on De La Rue's SAFEGUARD polymer substrate and joins the all-polymer ECCB series first introduced in 2019; ECCB Governor Timothy Antoine is quoted saying 'in De La Rue, we have a partner on whom we can rely.' The release does not say who printed the note.
source_title: De La Rue: Eastern Caribbean Central Bank Unveils Innovative $2 Polymer Banknote (De La Rue plc, via MarketScreener)

entity: Casa de Moneda (Sociedad del Estado, Argentina)
detail: Argentina's state mint, Casa de Moneda, printed 1,000- and 2,000-peso banknotes for the Banco Central de la República Argentina under three contracts dated November 2021, September 2022 and February 2023; the BCRA partially rescinded those contracts and Casa de Moneda stopped banknote production at 10pm on 28 October 2024, with the government announcing that 2,000-peso notes would no longer be printed.
source_title: Cambio de época: la Casa de Moneda de Argentina suspende la impresión de billetes (Bloomberg Línea)

entity: Fábrica Nacional de Moneda y Timbre
name_as_stated: la Fábrica Nacional de Moneda y Timbre de España
detail: The report states that Casa de Moneda had outsourced production of Argentina's 2,000-peso banknotes to Spain's Fábrica Nacional de Moneda y Timbre, and that the Banco Central de la República Argentina will receive a small portion of those notes; it also says 20,000-peso notes were imported from China without naming the manufacturer.
source_title: Cambio de época: la Casa de Moneda de Argentina suspende la impresión de billetes (Bloomberg Línea)

detail: Louisenthal states that OFAD (Oberthur Fiduciaire AD) has handled Bulgarian National Bank banknote production since 2014.
source_title: Award-winning 100-lev note for Bulgaria (Louisenthal)

detail: Louisenthal states that it supplied the paper-embedded security features - the thread, the foil and the watermark - for the Bulgarian National Bank's 100-lev banknote, which became legal tender on 28 December 2018 and won the High Security Printing EMEA award in Malta in March 2019. No specific paper product is named.
source_title: Award-winning 100-lev note for Bulgaria (Louisenthal)

detail: The National Banknote Printing Factory is reported to be a one-member limited liability company with 100% charter capital held by the state and to be responsible for printing banknotes, with its board chairman appointed by the Governor of the State Bank of Vietnam and its production plans assigned by the Governor; Nguyen Duc Cuong was appointed chairman for a five-year term, succeeding Le Thai Nam, who had led it since September 2019.
source_title: National Banknote Printing Factory has new chairman (The Investor)

entity: Banknote Printing House, Central Bank of Egypt
detail: The Central Bank of Egypt's own Banknote Printing House in the New Administrative Capital handles the full banknote production process from design to delivery at the Cash Centre, and its output covers Egypt's domestic needs with capacity that could also supply other countries in the region; a BCEAO delegation toured it on 10 March 2025. No capacity figures are given.
source_title: Egypt showcases world-class banknote printing facility to West African delegation (Amwal Al Ghad)
